'''Atlantik-Brücke''' ({{IPA|de|atˈlantɪkˌbʁʏkə|lang}}, ''Atlantic Bridge'') is a private non-profit association to [[Lobbying|promote]] German-American understanding and [[Atlanticism]]. Founded in [[Hamburg]] in 1952, it was located in Bonn between 1983 and 1999 and is now located in [[Berlin]].

The association organizes invitation-only conferences, seminars and colloquia. Through various programs for "Young Leaders", military officers, journalists, and students, Atlantik-Brücke fosters [[social network]]s among current and future leaders in business and world affairs. Atlantik-Brücke also awards prizes in honor of [[Vernon A. Walters]] and [[Eric M. Warburg]]. Atlantik-Brücke annually presents the George H.W. Bush award, an award given to those who have improved German and U.S. relations. It was first given in August 2015 to its namesake, U.S. statesman [[George H.W. Bush|Pres. George H. W. Bush]] at his residence [[Walker's Point Estate]], [[Maine]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=George H. W. Bush receives Award from Atlantik-Bruecke|url=https://www.atlantik-bruecke.org/en/george-h-w-bush-receives-award-from-atlantik-bruecke/|access-date=31 October 2020|date=28 August 2015}}</ref>

In 2014, the German political cabaret show ''Die Anstalt'' named the Atlantik-Brücke as one of several "[[NATO]]-friendly elite networks" that "are little more than transatlantic swinger-clubs".<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=13 January 2015|title=Die Anstalt ZDF: Transatlantische Netzwerke und Deutsche Medien|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y_bmegfMyVI |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/varchive/youtube/20211220/y_bmegfMyVI |archive-date=20 December 2021|url-status=live|access-date=26 June 2021|website=YouTube}}{{cbignore}}</ref> After exposing that several high-ranking German journalists and media moguls are members of the Atlantik-Brücke (among other American lobbying organisations), the broadcast criticised multiple widely circulated German newspapers as "being akin to local editions of the NATO press office".<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite book|last=Krüger|first=Uwe|title=Meinungsmacht: Der Einfluss von Eliten auf Leitmedien und Alpha-Journalisten – Eine kritische Netzwerkanalyse (Reihe des Europäischen Instituts für Journalismus- und Kommunikationsforschung)|publisher=Halem|year=2019|isbn=978-3-86962-459-4|edition=2., überarbeitete und erweiterte Auflage|location=Köln|language=de|oclc=1108148206}}</ref> Following the broadcast, several journalists whose connections to the Atlantik-Brücke were exposed attempted to sue the [[ZDF]] for broadcasting the show.<ref>{{Cite web|date=4 August 2014|title=Spart Zeit und Geld?|url=https://www.tagesspiegel.de/gesellschaft/medien/mal-eben-aus-der-zdf-mediathek-gekippt-spart-zeit-und-geld/10290136.html|url-status=live|access-date=25 June 2021|website=Der |archive-date=19 April 2021 }}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=Kompa|first=Markus|date=10 January 2017|title=Realsatiriker Josef Joffe und Jochen Bittner scheitern auch am BGH|url=https://www.heise.de/tp/news/Realsatiriker-Josef-Joffe-und-Jochen-Bittner-scheitern-auch-am-BGH-3592877.html|url-status=live|access-date=25 June 2021|website=Heise|language=de|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170110212857/https://www.heise.de/tp/news/Realsatiriker-Josef-Joffe-und-Jochen-Bittner-scheitern-auch-am-BGH-3592877.html ==Young Leaders==
The two Atlantik-Brücke Young Leaders conferences receive more than 500 applications per year, from which 120 Young Leaders are chosen with the help of a steering committee of political, business and academic leaders. Sixty young leaders are chosen for the German-American Conference (30 Americans and 30 Germans) and sixty are chosen for the European Conference. As of 2011, the German-American Young Leaders Conference has been running for 33 years.
{{Blockquote|The Young Leaders Program initiated by Atlantik-Brücke represents the oldest and largest program dedicated to identifying and nurturing relationships among the future custodians of the transatlantic partnership. Since the first Young Leaders Conference was held in 1973, over 1,500 Europeans and Americans have attended one of thirty-two German-American Young Leaders Conferences or ten European Young Leaders Conferences. Alumni of these prestigious gatherings remain in contact with each other both informally and through regional discussion groups and biennial alumni conferences that had been held under the auspices of Atlantik-Brücke. On January 1, 2011 Atlantik-Brücke established the independent organization "Atlantik Forum e.V. – the Young Leaders Alumni of Atlantik-Brücke" to more effectively facilitate and manage all these activities.}}
